boundaries.rootCause: Structured Marking Packs asked the provider to author both subquestion AO allocations and the aggregate allocation, then mechanically checked both. The structured compiler now requires an empty aggregate placeholder and deterministically derives the final aggregate from validated subquestion allocations before downstream factory validation.
